patterns.page_pattern: Dashboard pages are client components in app/(dashboard)/ directory with 'use client' directive
patterns.modal_pattern: Modal component from components/ui/modal.tsx for dialogs
patterns.diff_view_pattern: Audit page shows old_data vs new_data in modal - similar pattern for showing differences
patterns.service_pattern: Service functions in lib/services/ return {success, data, error} objects
patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support, semantic color classes (secondary-*, primary-*)
patterns.turkish_language: All UI text is in Turkish (Türkçe)

key_findings: compareSnapshots(organizationId, versionA, versionB) returns {success, addedProducts, removedProducts, addedCategories, removedCategories, error}
getSnapshotHistory(organizationId, options) returns list of snapshots with pagination
MenuSnapshotData interface defines complete snapshot structure with products and categories
Audit page demonstrates old_data vs new_data comparison in modal
All dashboard pages use Turkish language for UI text

feature_requirements.snapshot_list: Display all menu snapshots with version numbers and dates
feature_requirements.version_selection: Allow selecting two snapshots to compare
feature_requirements.comparison_view: Show side-by-side or diff view of added/removed products and categories
feature_requirements.integration: Add link from dashboard to snapshots page
